Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

Face: broad oval face; large hooded eyes and a broken brow line; prominent bridge, compact mouth; one cheek mole. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: dark-brown, shaved-close-cropped, deliberate accent: shaved temple geometry. Wardrobe: apron-workwear-layers, specifically a work shirt, asymmetrical apron layers, reinforced trousers, and sturdy shoes; a high soft collar and uneven layered hems; bounded palette indigo-sand. Visible personal details: one mismatched earring; a patterned collar insert; two plain rings. Make unusual but bounded color blocking the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: meticulous daily maintenance. Color treatment: uses the palette boldly in large blocks. Pose cue: stance is broad and still, with one palm turned slightly upward. Include a small empty medicine pouch only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
